name: biaomai-operations-platform
description: Open-source extensible AI desktop workbench (micro-kernel + hot-pluggable skills/MCP/canvas packs) with V1.0 global lead-generation suite.

scripts.setup:aionui: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && cd vendor/aionui && bun install
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm setup:aionui && pnpm install:aionui-packs
scripts.dev:aionui: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && if [ ! -d vendor/aionui/node_modules ]; then (cd vendor/aionui && bun install); fi && if [ -x "$(pwd)/vendor/aionui/bin/aioncore" ]; then export AIONUI_BACKEND_BIN="$(pwd)/vendor/aionui/bin/aioncore"; fi && cd vendor/aionui && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE bun run start
scripts.verify:all: pnpm verify:i18n && pnpm verify:licenses && pnpm verify:packs && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build:workbench
